tithi.name: Mokshada Ekadashi
tithi.description: Highly auspicious day dedicated to Lord Vishnu and celebrating Gita Jayanti, granting liberation and spiritual wisdom.

Mesha.summary: Channel your inward focus toward spiritual clarity and prudent planning.
Mesha.general: With the Moon transiting your twelfth house, you will benefit from taking time to recharge and reflect. Avoid unnecessary rushing and allow yourself space to decompress from hectic schedules.
Mesha.career: Focus on background tasks, research, and long-range planning rather than launching aggressive campaigns. Collaborations involving distant or overseas contacts bring constructive outcomes.
Mesha.finance: Expenses related to family welfare or charitable causes may increase today. Keep a watchful eye on impulsive online expenditures to maintain steady savings.
Mesha.relationships: Quiet understanding and compassionate communication will heal subtle misunderstandings. Spend peaceful moments with your partner away from noisy social gatherings.
Mesha.health: Prioritize quality sleep and gentle stretches to alleviate bodily fatigue. Meditation before bedtime will help calm an overactive mind.
Mesha.remedy: Chant the Vishnu Sahasranama or offer water to a Tulsi plant.

Vrishabha.summary: Expect productive networking and the smooth realization of cherished goals.
Vrishabha.general: The eleventh house Moon bestows harmony, meaningful social engagements, and favorable circumstances. Your optimism will attract supportive allies and mentor figures who believe in your vision.
Vrishabha.career: Collaborative ventures and group presentations will receive enthusiastic approval from seniors. Your capacity to coordinate diverse talents will make your workplace environment thrive.
Vrishabha.finance: Financial prospects look promising with possible gains through past investments or pending dues. A wise monetary choice made today promises long-term security.
Vrishabha.relationships: Friendships bring genuine joy and heartfelt conversations that lift your spirits. If single, socializing within your professional circle might introduce someone intriguing.
Vrishabha.health: Vitality remains elevated throughout the day, giving you ample stamina. Nourish your body with wholesome, seasonal foods to sustain this energetic rhythm.
Vrishabha.remedy: Offer white fragrant flowers or rice kheer to Goddess Lakshmi.

Mithuna.summary: Professional endeavors take center stage with high potential for leadership recognition.
Mithuna.general: A tenth house transit highlights your executive competence and decision-making capabilities. Stand tall in your convictions, as superiors will appreciate your transparent and proactive approach.
Mithuna.career: Important workplace responsibilities can be handled smoothly due to your sharp focus. This is an opportune time to present proposals or request new project assignments.
Mithuna.finance: Professional reputation translates directly into stable earnings and future growth prospects. Maintain a balanced approach to budgeting while considering career upgrades.
Mithuna.relationships: Balancing long working hours with family expectations requires gentle tact. Reassure your loved ones of their importance by dedicating quality evening time.
Mithuna.health: Minor posture fatigue or back tension may occur from prolonged desk work. Incorporate periodic walking breaks to maintain physical agility.
Mithuna.remedy: Recite the Budha Beej Mantra and feed green fodder to cows.

Karka.summary: Good fortune and spiritual wisdom pave the way for expansive horizons.
Karka.general: With the Moon gracing your ninth house of destiny, your intuitive faculties are heightened. Trust your inner compass when navigating critical choices, as divine grace supports your actions.
Karka.career: Matters involving higher studies, training, or long-distance agreements will move forward favorably. Mentors and experienced guides will readily offer sound counsel.
Karka.finance: Financial security is strengthened through disciplined planning and ethical practices. Investments in education or self-development yield fulfilling returns.
Karka.relationships: Philosophical and heart-to-heart dialogues with your partner deepen mutual respect. A family pilgrimage or spiritual discussion brings comforting domestic unity.
Karka.health: You will feel mentally peaceful and physically energized today. Outdoor walks in natural surroundings will replenish your inner vitality.

Simha.summary: Patience and emotional poise will transform challenging tasks into meaningful breakthroughs.
Simha.general: The eighth house transit urges you to practice emotional discretion and avoid hasty conclusions. Beneath temporary complications lie profound insights that will empower your personal growth.
Simha.career: Take time to review intricate details in reports, contracts, or audit matters. Maintaining a low profile and avoiding office politics will protect your professional interests.
Simha.finance: Be cautious regarding shared resources, loans, or sudden joint financial commitments. Stick strictly to pre-planned budgets and avoid speculative ventures today.
Simha.relationships: Unspoken sentiments could cause slight friction if not expressed constructively. Practice active listening and give your partner room to share their vulnerabilities.
Simha.health: Guard against digestive sluggishness and keep stress levels monitored. Opt for warm, easily digestible meals and stay properly hydrated.
Simha.remedy: Offer water mixed with red sandalwood and kumkum to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Collaborative synergy and warm relational bonds bring fruitful results.
Kanya.general: The Moon illuminating your seventh house fosters diplomacy, understanding, and mutual respect. Engaging openly with partners will clear previous doubts and foster solid teamwork.
Kanya.career: Client interactions, public relations, and joint ventures will see notable progress. Your analytical sharpness combined with cooperative charm will win valuable agreements.
Kanya.finance: Financial agreements and partnership contracts can be successfully negotiated today. Prudent mutual decisions ensure consistent monetary expansion.
Kanya.relationships: Romantic bonds blossom with sweet gestures and quality moments spent together. Open and affectionate dialogue restores harmony in marital life.
Kanya.health: General well-being remains stable, though balancing work with adequate rest is advised. Practice deep breathing exercises to maintain emotional composure.
Kanya.remedy: Donate green vegetables or fruits to those in need.

Tula.summary: Organized execution of daily duties grants a triumphant feeling of accomplishment.
Tula.general: A sixth house Moon fuels your problem-solving abilities and gives you the upper hand over obstacles. Diligence and structured routines will enable you to outshine any competition.
Tula.career: Colleagues will look to you for dependable solutions to operational challenges. Your systematic handling of pending paperwork clears accumulated backlogs effectively.
Tula.finance: Efforts directed at debt reduction and expense consolidation will succeed. Avoid lending money casually, maintaining clarity in all accounting.
Tula.relationships: Offer practical support to loved ones rather than over-analyzing minor emotional quirks. Your acts of service will be deeply appreciated by your partner.
Tula.health: Focus on gut health and refrain from overly rich or oily delicacies. Regular exercise or yoga will keep your energy levels humming throughout the day.
Tula.remedy: Feed birds grains and light a ghee lamp before Goddess Mahalakshmi.

Vrischika.summary: Unleash your creative flair and intellectual brilliance with confidence.
Vrischika.general: The fifth house transit brings inspiration, joyful self-expression, and renewed optimism. Trust your creative instincts, as your unique problem-solving approach brings admiration.
Vrischika.career: Brainstorming sessions and artistic projects receive great traction today. Your insights into ongoing dilemmas will impress colleagues and stakeholders alike.
Vrischika.finance: Calculated risks and well-researched financial plans can yield encouraging outcomes. Avoid hasty speculative bets, keeping your eye on steady growth.
Vrischika.relationships: Romance sparkles with warmth, playfulness, and deeper emotional resonance. Spending cheerful moments with children or creative hobbies brings immense happiness.
Vrischika.health: Mental cheerfulness translates into vibrant physical energy. Maintain this vitality by engaging in an uplifting hobby or recreational sport.
Vrischika.remedy: Recite Hanuman Chalisa and share sweets with children.

Dhanu.summary: Cultivate domestic serenity and ground your focus in foundational strength.
Dhanu.general: With the Moon transiting your fourth house, home and emotional peace become your sanctuary. Creating a clean, harmonious living space restores your confidence and inner equilibrium.
Dhanu.career: Work from a steady, methodical mindset rather than chasing urgent multitasking. Home-based work or real estate negotiations will progress with satisfying clarity.
Dhanu.finance: Expenditure toward home improvements, comfort, or maternal needs is indicated. Make sure any major asset decisions are vetted by trusted family members.
Dhanu.relationships: Meaningful conversations with maternal figures or elders will bring comforting reassurance. Emotional warmth strengthens your bond with your spouse and children.
Dhanu.health: Attend to emotional wellbeing; do not let external expectations disturb your composure. Gentle evening walks and soothing herbal teas are highly beneficial.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a chandan (sandalwood) tilak on your forehead and worship Lord Vishnu.

Makara.summary: Proactive communication and courageous initiatives drive swift progress today.
Makara.general: The third house Moon infuses you with determination, persuasive rhetoric, and energetic enthusiasm. Short travels and collaborative initiatives will yield productive results.
Makara.career: Your clear, assertive communication helps finalize stalled correspondence and project milestones. Sibling or junior colleague support will prove invaluable at work.
Makara.finance: Small investments in digital tools or skill-building workshops will pay future dividends. Financial stability allows you to plan your upcoming expenditures comfortably.
Makara.relationships: A lively and communicative atmosphere prevails with close associates and siblings. Express your affection freely to bridge any lingering emotional distance.
Makara.health: Your stamina remains robust, supporting an active and demanding day. Guard against minor throat or shoulder stiffness by staying relaxed.
Makara.remedy: Chant the Shani Mantra 'Om Sham Shanaicharaya Namah' in the evening.

Kumbha.summary: Consolidate your wealth and speak with gracious clarity to inspire trust.
Kumbha.general: The Moon moving through your second house highlights family values, resource management, and refined speech. Your words hold constructive influence, helping resolve delicate family matters.
Kumbha.career: Financial discussions, wage negotiations, and budget reviews receive positive impetus. Present your viewpoints logically to garner senior consensus.
Kumbha.finance: A propitious day for organizing family savings and securing liquid assets. You may discover practical avenues to augment your secondary income streams.
Kumbha.relationships: Sweetness in your tone cultivates a joyous domestic atmosphere. Enjoy a nourishing family dinner where shared memories bring genuine closeness.
Kumbha.health: Pay attention to oral hygiene and maintain balanced nutritional intake. Stay mindful of eye strain if working extensively on digital monitors.
Kumbha.remedy: Donate food grains or white sesame seeds to the underprivileged.

Meena.summary: Embrace your heightened intuition and step boldly into renewed self-expression.
Meena.general: With the Moon transiting your own sign on Mokshada Ekadashi, your personal aura is radiant and magnetic. Your sensitive, empathetic nature will inspire everyone who crosses your path.
Meena.career: Take the initiative on creative ideas and present your vision with authentic conviction. Your leadership style will be appreciated for its empathy and strategic balance.
Meena.finance: Personal investments in wellness or self-enhancement will bring genuine satisfaction. Manage your resources wisely while maintaining an optimistic fiscal outlook.
Meena.relationships: Your personal warmth fosters loving harmony and draws people close to your heart. Deep emotional bonding and honest sharing characterize your romantic life.
Meena.health: Vitality is rejuvenated, bringing emotional tranquility and mental lightness. Practice mindfulness and stay centered through quiet contemplation.
Meena.remedy: Recite the Bhagavad Gita Chapter 12 or 15 on this sacred Gita Jayanti day.

tithi.name: Shukla Trayodashi
tithi.description: Auspicious for worshipping Lord Shiva and seeking longevity, spiritual wisdom, and freedom from karmic debts.

Mesha.summary: High vitality and focus enable bold decision-making today.
Mesha.general: With the Moon transiting your lagna, your confidence and natural leadership traits will shine brightly. Embrace fresh opportunities and set clear intentions for upcoming personal projects.
Mesha.career: Colleagues look to you for direction on critical tasks. Proactive communication helps seal an advantageous agreement.
Mesha.finance: Personal investments made after due diligence yield satisfying promises. Avoid impulsive spending on luxury novelties.
Mesha.relationships: Warmth and mutual respect uplift your domestic atmosphere. Single natives may encounter intriguing individuals.
Mesha.health: Energy levels remain robust, but adequate hydration is essential. Balance mental drive with light stretches.
Mesha.remedy: Chant the Hanuman Chalisa and offer red flowers to Lord Hanuman.

Vrishabha.summary: Reflective energy guides thoughtful budgeting and spiritual clarity.
Vrishabha.general: The Moon in your twelfth house invites inward retreat and reassessment of priorities. Solitary activities and meditation will provide the emotional balance you seek.
Vrishabha.career: Foreign collaborations or research-intensive assignments show positive movement. Keep your strategies confidential for now.
Vrishabha.finance: Expenses related to family welfare or health could arise. Exercise restraint against unexpected online purchases.
Vrishabha.relationships: Avoid overanalyzing small remarks made by your partner. Compassionate listening strengthens your emotional bond.
Vrishabha.health: Ensure restful sleep to prevent eye strain and mild fatigue. Unwind with calming herbal tea before bed.
Vrishabha.remedy: Offer raw milk and sesame seeds to a Shivling during evening hours.

Mithuna.summary: Networking and social synergies open promising avenues of prosperity.
Mithuna.general: Your eleventh house activation brings support from influential friends and social circles. Long-cherished wishes find fertile ground for realization today.
Mithuna.career: Collaborative ventures receive encouragement from senior management. Your innovative suggestions will be well received.
Mithuna.finance: Financial gains through multiple channels or side projects are likely. A favorable time for portfolio diversification.
Mithuna.relationships: Celebrations with peers create memorable joyful moments. Meaningful conversations deepen romantic harmony.
Mithuna.health: Overall stamina is high and mental agility remains sharp. Keep up your active lifestyle routines.
Mithuna.remedy: Feed green fodder or spinach to cows and chant 'Om Budhaya Namaha'.

Karka.summary: Professional diligence commands well-deserved recognition and progress.
Karka.general: The Moon presiding over your tenth house highlights duty, prestige, and executive power. Maintain an upright, focused demeanor to make significant career leaps.
Karka.career: Your dedication captures the admiration of superiors and clients. New organizational responsibilities may be entrusted to you.
Karka.finance: Steady career progress translates into future financial security. Budget carefully for professional enhancements.
Karka.relationships: Balance long work hours with quality time for domestic peace. A reassuring word will comfort your elders.
Karka.health: Watch out for posture stiffness around the neck and shoulders. Take regular pauses during extended desk work.
Karka.remedy: Offer water mixed with white sandalwood paste to the rising Sun.

Simha.summary: Fortunate tides support scholarly pursuits and philosophical insight.
Simha.general: With the Moon blessing your ninth house of dharma and fortune, optimism returns abundantly. Mentors and father figures offer pivotal guidance for your aspirations.
Simha.career: Tasks involving publishing, legal counsel, or cross-border commerce thrive. Your ethical standing boosts professional credibility.
Simha.finance: Gains through long-term financial holdings or ancestral matters are indicated. Charitable giving brings inner peace.
Simha.relationships: Spiritual conversations with your partner cultivate deeper understanding. Singles may connect with someone cultured.
Simha.health: Vitality is elevated, fostering an upbeat physical state. Outdoor walks in fresh air will revitalize your mind.
Simha.remedy: Apply a tilak of saffron or sandalwood paste on your forehead.

Kanya.summary: Patience and emotional calm overcome complex underlying challenges.
Kanya.general: The Moon in your eighth house encourages cautious stepping and psychological transformation. Steer clear of haste, gossip, and unnecessary confrontation.
Kanya.career: Scrutinize shared accounts, tax reports, and contracts thoroughly. Discretion in workplace dynamics is your greatest shield.
Kanya.finance: Unexpected overheads could test your liquidity today. Avoid entering joint monetary liabilities or lending money.
Kanya.relationships: Be transparent with your partner to avoid baseless misunderstandings. Empathy will heal lingering family disputes.
Kanya.health: Pay attention to digestive sensitivity and stay hydrated. Practice pranayama to dispel latent anxieties.
Kanya.remedy: Light a mustard oil lamp under a Peepal tree in the evening.

Tula.summary: Harmonious collaborations and partner support enrich your endeavors.
Tula.general: Transiting your seventh house, the Moon radiates grace into your relationships and public engagements. Mutual compromise brings mutual success across all fronts.
Tula.career: Joint ventures and negotiations yield mutually beneficial terms. Your diplomatic flair resolves contentious matters smoothly.
Tula.finance: Commercial pacts and client retention improve income stability. Good day for legal reviews and agreements.
Tula.relationships: Romance blossoms through heartfelt appreciation and shared leisure. Married life experiences renewed closeness.
Tula.health: Overall wellbeing remains stable and radiant. Engage in gentle aerobic exercises to maintain suppleness.
Tula.remedy: Donate white grains or rice to the needy and worship Goddess Lakshmi.

Vrischika.summary: Disciplined execution and tenacity grant victory over lingering hurdles.
Vrischika.general: The Moon in the sixth house empowers you to tackle pending chores and surpass rivals effortlessly. Your analytical efficiency turns difficulties into stepping stones.
Vrischika.career: Operational routines run smoothly under your watchful management. Subordinates offer sincere and competent assistance.
Vrischika.finance: Prudent budget cuts help you settle pending debts faster. Avoid speculation or risky short-term schemes.
Vrischika.relationships: Steer clear of critical language with loved ones. Supportive companionship emerges when you express gratitude.
Vrischika.health: Maintain dietary moderation to avoid mild acidity. A brisk evening walk will boost your physical stamina.
Vrischika.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 11 times and offer jaggery to birds.

Dhanu.summary: Creative inspiration and joyful intellect elevate your overall outlook.
Dhanu.general: With the Moon lighting up your fifth house, artistic insight, learning, and romance take center stage. Trust your intuitive instincts when formulating fresh strategies.
Dhanu.career: Creative projects receive accolades from clients and mentors. Those in education or arts will experience breakthroughs.
Dhanu.finance: Intellectual skills generate viable opportunities for additional revenue. Moderate speculative caution is advised.
Dhanu.relationships: Romantic sparks reignite through playful and heartfelt interactions. Children bring moments of pride and happiness.
Dhanu.health: Mental clarity fosters high vitality and physical cheerfulness. Stay active through recreational hobbies.
Dhanu.remedy: Chant 'Om Brihaspataye Namaha' and apply turmeric tilak to your throat.

Makara.summary: Cultivating domestic peace and mental composure restores inner strength.
Makara.general: The Moon's journey through your fourth house invites attention to home, mother, and emotional roots. Create a tranquil sanctuary to recharge your batteries.
Makara.career: Maintain steady persistence on foundational tasks rather than rushing expansions. Property and remote work endeavors progress well.
Makara.finance: Expenditures on domestic upgrades or vehicle maintenance are anticipated. Sound long-term planning prevents cash crunch.
Makara.relationships: Warm exchanges with family elders provide grounding reassurance. Express appreciation to your life partner.
Makara.health: Guard against respiratory chill and chest heaviness. Warm herbal drinks and light meals will prove soothing.
Makara.remedy: Offer water to a Peepal tree and chant 'Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namaha'.

Kumbha.summary: Decisive enterprise, courage, and short journeys produce fruitful results.
Kumbha.general: The third house Moon activates your courage, communication skills, and initiative. It is a splendid day for expressing your ideas and initiating bold projects.
Kumbha.career: Marketing, media, and writing initiatives achieve prompt traction. Siblings or colleagues extend helpful support.
Kumbha.finance: Gains through commercial transit and short contractual assignments are highlighted. Prudent handling stabilizes savings.
Kumbha.relationships: Upbeat conversations revitalize bonds with peers and cousins. Honest dialogue clears any old lingering doubt.
Kumbha.health: Stamina is excellent, inspiring you to take up fitness goals. Practice shoulder stretches to ease minor tension.
Kumbha.remedy: Feed stray black dogs with bread or biscuits smeared with mustard oil.

Meena.summary: Financial clarity and sweet speech facilitate prosperous family milestones.
Meena.general: The Moon in your second house enhances oratorical charm and fiscal consciousness. Your words carry comforting warmth, drawing positive resources to your side.
Meena.career: Negotiations regarding salary, resources, or budget allocations lean in your favor. Your pleasant communication charms peers.
Meena.finance: Accumulated savings show positive growth through careful management. Good day to review bank accounts and assets.
Meena.relationships: Family get-togethers bring harmony and joy to the household. A shared celebratory meal strengthens family unity.
Meena.health: Vocal cords and dental hygiene warrant standard care. Stick to balanced, warm, and freshly prepared meals.
Meena.remedy: Recite the Vishnu Sahasranama or chant 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya'.
